strap.note: Accounts are optional: heroes always stay on this device

help.title: Accounts and recovery codes
help.accounts: An account is optional. It syncs your heroes between devices and lets you join campaigns from any of them. There is no e-mail.
help.recovery: The six recovery codes shown when you create an account are the only way back in if you forget the password. Each works once; Herokeep does not keep them.
help.devices: The device name only helps you tell your devices apart in Settings, where you can sign any of them out.

login.title: Log in
login.deviceLabelHint: Shown in Settings, Devices, so you can sign this device out from another one.
login.redirected: Log in to open {section, select, campaigns {Campaigns} heroes {Heroes} library {the Library} packs {Packs} settings {Settings} other {that page}}. You'll be taken there afterwards.

register.title: Create account
register.usernameHint: 3 to 32 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.
register.passwordHint: At least 10 characters, at most 128; not your username; not a common password.
register.deviceLabelHint: You can rename or sign out devices later in Settings.
register.reasonIncomplete: Enter a valid username and a password that passes the rules first
register.strengthTip: {count, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}, not a common password
register.loginLink: Already have an account? Log in

codesStep.title: Save your recovery codes
codesStep.intro: These six one-time codes are the only way back into your account if you forget your password. Save them somewhere safe now — they are shown only this once and Herokeep never stores them.
codesStep.copy-failed: Couldn't copy. Select the codes or download them instead.
codesStep.strapNote: Leaving without saving asks to confirm
codesStep.reasonUnchecked: Tick "I saved my recovery codes" first

confirmLeave.title: Leave without saving your codes?
confirmLeave.message: These recovery codes will never be shown again. If you leave now without saving them, you could lose access to your account if you forget your password.

recover.title: Recover account
recover.codeHint: One of the six codes saved at registration. It is used up afterwards.
recover.newPasswordHint: At least 10 characters; not your username; not a common password.
recover.strapNote: Enabled once every field is valid
recover.reasonIncomplete: Enter your username, a recovery code and a new password that passes the rules first
recover.signOutNotice: Resetting the password signs out all other devices. This one stays signed in.

validation.invalidUsername: Usernames are 3–32 letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.
validation.tooShort: Password must be at least 10 characters.
validation.tooLong: Password must be at most 128 characters.
validation.common: That password is too common — please choose another.
validation.containsUsername: Password must not contain your username.

errors.lockout: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
errors.badRequest: Something about that request wasn't valid.
errors.network: You're offline — check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
